jobs.name: voice-transcription-medium
jobs.prompt:
Run /root/.hermes/scripts/audio_transcription_medium.sh which processes 37 × 2-min chunks using the medium Whisper model. The script has resume logic (skips already done chunks). Wait for it to complete (~60 min). Then:

1. Check progress: ls /tmp/hermes_audio_transcription/chunks_out/ | wc -l
2. If less than 37, run script again (resume)
4. When 37/37 done, concatenate all *_plain.md files in /tmp/hermes_audio_transcription/chunks_out/ into /tmp/hermes_audio_transcription/final/full_transcript.md (in order)
5. Report final stats

jobs.name: audio-postprocess-jev
jobs.prompt:
Run the postprocess + JEV pipeline. It will process all 37 chunks from /tmp/hermes_audio_transcription/chunks_out/.

Steps:
1. Execute: bash /root/.hermes/scripts/audio_postprocess_all.sh
   This runs transcription-postprocess on each chunk_*.wav's _words.json, then JEV quality gate. Each chunk takes ~15 seconds (LLM + JEV). Total ~10-15 min for all 37.
2. The script has SKIP logic for already-done work, so it can be re-run if needed.
3. Wait for completion, then:
   a. Count successful evaluations: ls /tmp/hermes_audio_transcription/quality_eval/ | wc -l
   b. Aggregate JEV scores into summary statistics (avg, min, max, count of low-quality chunks)
   c. Concatenate all postprocess MD files into /tmp/hermes_audio_transcription/final/full_postprocessed.md (in order: chunk_000, chunk_001, ..., chunk_036)
   d. Report final stats

Do not stop until all 37 chunks have both _postprocess.md and _quality.json files.

jobs.name: ba-modeling-transcribe
jobs.prompt:
Run the BA modeling lecture transcription pipeline. The script processes a 17.8-minute audio file split into 9 chunks of 2 minutes each.

Steps:
1. Execute: bash /root/.hermes/scripts/ba_modeling_transcribe.sh
   This will:
   - Split audio into 2-min chunks
   - Transcribe each chunk using medium model + ba_modeling.txt prompt
   - Skip already-completed chunks (resume logic)
2. Wait for completion (~20-30 min)
3. When done:
   a. Verify: ls /tmp/ba_modeling_audio/chunks_out/ | wc -l (should be 9)
   b. Concatenate all *_plain.md files in /tmp/ba_modeling_audio/chunks_out/ into /tmp/ba_modeling_audio/final/ba_modeling_raw.md (in order: chunk_000, chunk_001, ..., chunk_008)
   c. Report final stats: chunks completed, total time, total words

If script fails or hangs, check logs in /tmp/ba_modeling_audio/logs/ and report what happened.

jobs.name: ba-modeling-v2-overlap
jobs.prompt:
Run the BA modeling v2 pipeline: overlap transcription + LLM dedup + multi-pass postprocess + cleanup.

Execute: bash /root/.hermes/scripts/ba_modeling_v2.sh

The script does:
1. Transcribes 17.8-min audio with 15-sec overlap (creates ~10 chunks of 2 min)
2. Deduplicates overlap zones via LLM
3. Runs 4 LLM passes: filler removal, ASR error fix, structure (## headings), polish
4. Final cleanup

Expected time: ~30-50 min total.

When done, report:
- Final file: /tmp/ba_modeling_audio/final/ba_modeling_v2.md
- Word count
- Number of chunks used (overlap creates more than original 9)
- Any errors in logs

If any step fails, report what failed and the log output.

jobs.name: ba-modeling-v3-conservative
jobs.prompt:
Run the BA modeling v3 CONSERVATIVE pipeline. This is the FIX for the problem that v2 was too aggressive in editing.

Execute: bash /root/.hermes/scripts/ba_modeling_v3.sh

This pipeline does:
1. Transcribe 17.8-min audio with 1-MIN chunks and 30-sec overlap (creates ~22 chunks, each fragment appears in 2-3 chunks)
2. LLM stitch: for each pair of consecutive overlap chunks, LLM produces a CLEAN TRANSITION that keeps ALL semantic content (NO removal, NO paraphrase)
3. Pass 1: punctuation ONLY (. , ? ! : — ;) + paragraph breaks based on detected pauses. STRICT rule: do not change any word.
4. Pass 2: ASR fix only (known errors: имперический→эмпирический, сниженка→снежинка, etc.)
5. Final cleanup

EXPECTED TIME: ~60-80 min total (22 chunks × 1.5 min transcription + 21 LLM stitches + 2 postprocess passes)

When done, report:
- Final file: /tmp/ba_modeling_audio/final/ba_modeling_v3.md
- Word count (should be ~2200-2400, similar to raw, NOT shorter like v2)
- Total time
- Any errors in logs

CRITICAL: The goal is to PRESERVE all lecturer's words, not produce a polished literary text. If postprocess deleted too many words, the fix needs to be even more conservative.
